title: Unpopular opinion: Link should talk
caption: Unpopular opinion: Link should talk. Agree or disagree? #zelda #link #nintendo #gaming #fyp

instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: Link should talk.

Link reacts to everything with the same face. A voice would give him a personality. Zelda got a voice and became the most interesting character in Breath of the Wild. Silent heroes worked in 1986. In 2026 it just feels empty. Agree?
